lines.speaker: tobin_fell
lines.text: Fire is thinning. Last shard came on market credit. I am not buying another winter on those terms.
lines.direction: Orus's natural conversational register, working blacksmith, dry and laconic; do not force an extra bass pitch.

options.label: We will find honest fuel at the docks.
We could ask Rook about supplies.
We will leave you to your work.

lines.speaker: tobin_fell
lines.text: Dry charcoal in the dock stores, if any is left. Not a shard. I need a working fire, not another debt.
lines.direction: Orus's natural conversational register, working blacksmith, dry and laconic; do not force an extra bass pitch.

lines.speaker: tobin_fell
lines.text: Rook works the lower landing. Tell them I want fuel, not promises. And get the terms before you shake hands.
lines.direction: Orus's natural conversational register, working blacksmith, dry and laconic; do not force an extra bass pitch.

lines.speaker: tobin_fell
lines.text: Dock stores for charcoal, or Rook at the lower landing. Corvin might tell you why the cold bites so deep.
lines.direction: Orus's natural conversational register, working blacksmith, dry and laconic; do not force an extra bass pitch.

lines.speaker: tobin_fell
lines.text: Dry charcoal. That will hold the heat long enough for a day's work. What terms am I taking?
lines.direction: Orus's natural conversational register, working blacksmith, dry and laconic; do not force an extra bass pitch.

options.label: The fuel is yours. Keep the forge working.

lines.speaker: tobin_fell
lines.text: A day's fire is a day's work. Take this oil. Good tools deserve looking after.
lines.direction: Orus's natural conversational register, working blacksmith, dry and laconic; do not force an extra bass pitch.

lines.speaker: tobin_fell
lines.text: Still needs tending. But it is a fire I can pay for.
lines.direction: Orus's natural conversational register, working blacksmith, dry and laconic; do not force an extra bass pitch.

lines.speaker: tobin_fell
lines.text: Shut the door behind you. Saves what heat there is.
lines.direction: Orus's natural conversational register, working blacksmith, dry and laconic; do not force an extra bass pitch.
